newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P gives Advantage AA-minus claims paying rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives Advantage AA-minus claims paying rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it has assigned its AA-minus claims paying ability rating to Advantage Lenders Mortgage Insurance Pty Ltd, based on a guarantee provided by majority shareholder MGICA Ltd.
MGICA is rated AA-minus for claims-paying ability.

S&P said Advantage was a new captive mortgage insurance company 50.1 percent owned by MGICA, wholly-owned by the Australian Mutual Provident Society group (AMP), which is rated AAA for claims paying ability, and 49.9 percent owned by Advance Bank Australia Ltd (rated A/A-1).
Advance Bank is a subsidiary of St George Bank Ltd, which is also rated A/A-1.
Advantage started operations on January 8 this year and is supported by MGICA under an unconditional guarantee, in addition to a management service agreement and reinsurance treaty.
